hooks.command: bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); if echo "$S" | grep -qi merge; then echo "Merge session — assessment not required"; else [ ! -f "docs/assessments/session-${S}-assessment.md" ] && echo "Missing assessment file" && exit 1; fi; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && echo "Uncommitted files" && git status --porcelain && exit 1; exit 0'
echo 'WARNING: /compact is BANNED in Rhodesli. Use /clear instead. /compact is lossy and causes instruction amnesia. This will be logged as a RED FLAG in session assessment.' >&2 && exit 0

echo 'PARALLELIZATION CHECK: Before starting, analyze this prompt for parallel opportunities. Independent phases (different files) can use worktree-isolated subagents. Max 3-4 worktrees. Merge: docs first, then code.'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\bgit commit\b"; then if [ -f .claude/parallel_session_active ]; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit to main during parallel session." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null | xargs dirname); PYTEST="${REPO}/venv/bin/pytest"; [ ! -f "$PYTEST" ] && PYTEST=venv/bin/pytest; $PYTEST tests/ -x -q -n auto -m "not slow" --timeout=10 2>&1 | tail -5; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}); print(d.get(\"file_path\",d.get(\"path\",\"\")))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(rhodesli_ml|core)/.*\.py$"; then echo "REMINDER: Update ALGORITHMIC_DECISIONS.md if this changes ML behavior." >&2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git commit|git merge"; then echo "REMINDER: Run make test-fast before proceeding."; fi; exit 0'
